title: How to Get the Link and QR Code to Ask for Google Reviews
description: Step-by-step tutorial to copy your Google listing's review link and download its QR code, plus what you must not do when asking customers for reviews.

answer.question: How do I get the link and QR code to ask for reviews on Google?
answer.text: Go to business.google.com, click "Read reviews" and then "Get more reviews": there you copy the link and download your listing's QR code.

intro: Many customers never leave a review simply because they do not know where to click. A direct link or a QR code removes that barrier, and you can get both for free from your Google Business Profile.

body.text: Asking for reviews is one of the things that helps a local business stand out on Google most, but many customers skip it out of sheer laziness: they do not know where to click. A direct link or a QR code removes that barrier.

Google explains in its official help that you can remind customers to leave a review by asking them to visit a Google link or scan a QR code. Customers need to sign in to a Google account to post it, although it does not have to be a Gmail address.

One rule is worth keeping clear: reviews must reflect a genuine experience, and Google strictly prohibits offering incentives, such as free or discounted products or services, in exchange for posting or changing a review, or for removing a negative one. Google treats this as fake engagement and your listing can be restricted.

What does work is asking well: right after a good service, in a friendly way and without pressure, with the link one tap away. A QR code on the counter or on the receipt works very well in shops, bars and clinics.

items: You do it from a computer, at business.google.com
The same link works for email, WhatsApp or a post
Offering discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews is prohibited
Whoever writes the review needs a Google account
Go to your Business Profile. Open business.google.com with the Google account that manages your listing. Your listing must be verified.
Open your reviews. Click "Read reviews". Inside you will see the "Get more reviews" option, with the share icon next to it.
Copy the link. Click the copy icon. That link takes the customer straight to writing a review of your business.
Download the QR code. Right-click the QR code and choose "Save image as…". According to Google, review QR codes can for now only be generated from a desktop browser.
Share it with your customers. You can send it by email, WhatsApp or in a Facebook post, or print the QR and put it on the counter, the receipt or the business card.
Copy your listing's review link today and save it in your notes
Download the QR and print it for the counter or the receipt
Prepare a short WhatsApp message with the link to send after each service
Do not offer discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews

faq.q: Do my customers need a Gmail account to leave a review?
faq.a: They need to sign in to a Google account, but it does not have to be a Gmail address.

faq.q: Can I generate the QR code from my phone?
faq.a: According to Google, review QR codes can for now only be generated from a desktop browser.

faq.q: Can I give a discount to customers who leave a review?
faq.a: No. Google strictly prohibits incentives in exchange for reviews and your listing can be restricted.
